itineraries.name: Alia Soul
itineraries.summary: Dive the Red Sea aboard the Alia Soul liveaboard, a 36m (118ft) diving boat with 10 cabins for 20 guests, spacious dive decks, Nitrox, and itineraries to top northern and southern dive sites.

itineraries.name: All Star Ghani
itineraries.summary: Explore the Red Sea aboard the All Star Ghani liveaboard, offering 12 cabins for 24 guests, up to 18 dives weekly, and access to Egypt’s top reefs, wrecks, and shark hotspots.

itineraries.name: All Star Scuba Scene
itineraries.summary: Red Sea wrecks and reefs! All Star Scuba Scene takes you to Egypt's iconic dive sites and untouched treasures

itineraries.name: ALSURAYA
itineraries.summary: The ALSURAYA is a Red Sea liveaboard offering spacious cabins, top-tier amenities, and unforgettable diving and kiteboarding adventures across world-class sites.

itineraries.name: Amelie
itineraries.summary: With only 12 guests onboard the Amelie Safari offers a more bespoke Red Sea liveaboard experience.Choose from 3 or 7-night dive itineraries.

itineraries.name: Amelie Adventures
itineraries.summary: The Amelie Adventures is a 27-meter/88.6-foot-long liveaboard taking 16 guests on diving adventures in the Red Sea. Snorkeler friendly and available for charters.

itineraries.name: Aphrodite
itineraries.summary: The MY Aphrodite offers year-round dive safaris in the Egyptian Red Sea. Itineraries cover the best Red Sea dive areas, from northern dive sites such as Ras Mohammed to the deep south of St. Johns.

itineraries.name: ASHRAFI
itineraries.summary: Sail the Red Sea aboard the ASHRAFI Liveaboard. Enjoy dive safaris, ensuite cabins, gourmet dining, and island-hopping from Hurghada.

itineraries.name: AVO
itineraries.summary: The AVO offers Red Sea diving and 12 ensuite cabins, spacious decks, fresh cuisine, and expertly curated dive itineraries from Ras Mohamed to St. John’s.

itineraries.name: Bella 2
itineraries.summary: The Bella 2 is a 35-meter/115-foot-long liveaboard taking 24 guests on diving safaris in Egypt’s Red Sea, including Brothers, Daedalus, Elphinstone reefs, the Thistegorm wreck, and more.

itineraries.name: Bella 3
itineraries.summary: The Bella 3 is a 32-meter/105-foot-long liveaboard taking 20 guests on diving safaris in Egypt’s Red Sea, including Brothers, Daedalus, Elphinstone reefs, the Thistegorm wreck, and more.

itineraries.name: Bismarck
itineraries.summary: Experience luxury and adventure aboard the Bismarck, a 46-meter Red Sea liveaboard offering 17 cabins and thrilling dives in sites like Brothers, Daedalus, and Ras Muhammad.

itineraries.name: Blue
itineraries.summary: The MY Blue is a modern liveaboard offering luxury Red Sea dive trips. Catering for 24 guests, all cabins are en-suite, and sea-view rooms are available.

itineraries.name: Blue Diamond
itineraries.summary: Dive the Red Sea aboard Blue Diamond, a 35m liveaboard for 28 guests, with 14 ensuite cabins, spacious social areas, and varied itineraries.

itineraries.name: Blue Horizon
itineraries.summary: The award-winning Blue Horizon yacht offers fantastic Red Sea dive safaris covering all the world-class dive sites of Egypt.

itineraries.name: Blue Melody
itineraries.summary: The Blue Melody yacht offers year-round diving in the Red Sea. She caters to 26 divers in 13 air-conditioned, ensuite cabins.

itineraries.name: Blue Pearl
itineraries.summary: The Blue Pearl liveaboard combines comfort with convenience. En-suite cabins and multiple lounging areas offer relaxation in between exciting Red Sea dives.

itineraries.name: Blue Seas
itineraries.summary: Join the Blue Seas liveaboard for a 7-night itinerary at some of the the Red Sea's most iconic dive sites. Double and twin cabins with en-suite bathrooms.

itineraries.name: Blue Storm
itineraries.summary: The Blue Storm is a modern liveaboard operating in the Red Sea, Egypt. With 24 guests maximum, 11 Double cabins all with en-suite facilities, Blue Storm visits the most popular dive sites in the Red Sea.

itineraries.name: Carlton
itineraries.summary: The Carlton liveaboard sails 7-day Red Sea itineraries to Ras Mohammed, Tiran, and St. John's, with 10 en suite cabins for up to 20 guests.

itineraries.name: CU
itineraries.summary: Dive the Red Sea aboard the CU, a 38m (125-foot) liveaboard offering superb itineraries to iconic wrecks and reefs, professional service, and relaxed diving year-round.

itineraries.name: Destiny
itineraries.summary: Destiny is a luxurious Red Sea liveaboard accommodating 20 divers in 10 ensuite cabins. Eco-minded à-la-carte dining, spacious dive deck, sun deck, and iconic routes (BD/E, St. John’s).

itineraries.name: Discovery I
itineraries.summary: The Discovery I liveaboard offers 7-night itineraries covering the best of the Red Sea. 10 en-suite cabins cater to 20 guests. Sea view cabins are available.

itineraries.name: Discovery II
itineraries.summary: Red Sea adventure awaits! Discovery II explores Egypt's iconic dive sites and untouched treasures

itineraries.name: DUNE Longara
itineraries.summary: Discover the DUNE Longara liveaboard in Egypt, a luxury Red Sea vessel for 30 guests offering stylish cabins, a Jacuzzi, fine dining, and unforgettable dive itineraries.

itineraries.name: DUNE Silky
itineraries.summary: DUNE Silky liveaboard is a modern, spacious yacht in the Red Sea, Egypt. With 13 twin en-suite and air-conditioned cabins for up to 26 guests, Alia offers dive itineraries to top Red Sea spots such as Daedalus, St, John’s and Brothers.

itineraries.name: DUNE Titan
itineraries.summary: Join the DUNE Titan for a budget-friendly Red Sea liveaboard. The 39m Titan offers year-round dive safaris to the best Egyptian dive sites, including the Ras Mohammed Marine Park, Straits of Tiran, St. Johns, Brothers, and Elphinstone.

itineraries.name: Emperor Asmaa
itineraries.summary: Emperor Asmaa offers true value for money while diving the Red Sea. 10 ensuite cabins to cater for 20 guests on board. Free nitrox, WiFi and wine with dinner.

itineraries.name: Emperor Elite
itineraries.summary: The Emperor Elite, winner of Best Liveaboard 2020 offers year-round diving to some of the best spots in the Red Sea. Free nitrox and WiFi are included.

itineraries.name: Emperor Superior
itineraries.summary: The Emperor Superior is perfectly set up for photographers to enjoy week-long itineraries in the Red Sea. Many trips allow for 21+ dives per week.

itineraries.name: Eriny
itineraries.summary: The Eriny is a liveaboard offering 10 air-conditioned ensuite cabins, top-notch facilities, and expertly curated Red Sea itineraries featuring sites like the Thistlegorm, Abu Nuhas, and Tiran Strait.

itineraries.name: Freedom III
itineraries.summary: The Freedom III liveaboard explores the Northern Red Sea with 3 - 6 night itineraries. 9 En-suite cabins are on-board, each with AC, TV & DVD, fridge & safe. There are also 2 sun decks for relaxation.

itineraries.name: Freedom IV
itineraries.summary: The Freedom IV is a 28-meter/92-feet-long liveaboard based in Sharm El Sheikh, Egypt, taking 24 guests in 11 air-conditioned cabins on diving safaris in the northern Red Sea, including Thitlegorm and Ras Mohammed.

itineraries.name: Ghazala Adventure
itineraries.summary: Explore the Red Sea aboard the Ghazala Adventure, hosting 26 guests with air-conditioned cabins, gourmet buffets, free Nitrox, and diverse itineraries from wrecks to pristine reefs.

itineraries.name: Ghazala Explorer
itineraries.summary: Ghazala Explorer liveaboard in the Egyptian Red Sea is a modern motor yacht with 12 ensuite cabins, taking up to 24 guests to top sites in the Red Sea. Visit Daedalus, St. Johns, Elphinstone, Ras Mohammed, or the Thistlegorm wreck.

itineraries.name: Golden Dolphin
itineraries.summary: The MY Golden Dolphin liveaboard offers year-round diving to the best Red Sea dive sites, from the north to far south. 10 en-suite, air-conditioned cabins cater to 20 guests. Nitrox is available onboard.

itineraries.name: Golden Dolphin IV
itineraries.summary: The Golden Dolphin IV is a 46mtr/151ft long liveaboard in Egypt taking guests to some of the most iconic dive sites in the Red Sea.

itineraries.name: Golden Imperial
itineraries.summary: Luxury Red Sea diving aboard the Golden Imperial with 14 cabins, Nitrox, spacious decks, and routes to Brothers, Daedalus & St. Johns.

itineraries.name: Gordon Reef Liveaboard Diving
itineraries.summary: With a host of large and small marine life, a Gordon Reef liveaboard has it all. The wreck of the Louilla, critters such as nudibranchs, shrimp, octopuses, a variety of eels and large schools of fish can be seen when diving on the reefs and, occasionally, oceanic whitetips and hammerheads sharks.

itineraries.name: Grand Discovery
itineraries.summary: Experience luxury diving in the Red Sea aboard MY Grand Discovery—24 cabins, Jacuzzi skydeck, full-service bar, and epic itineraries to Thistlegorm, Brothers, Daedalus, and beyond.

itineraries.name: Hamata Liveaboard Diving
itineraries.summary: Hamata offers guests some of the newest dive areas in Egypt. Bright coral reefs, white-tipped reef sharks and pods of spinner dolphins make liveaboard diving here an unforgettable experience. The wrecks at Soraya have created beautiful self-contained ecosystems. It's also rapidly becoming a hotspot for kite-surfers.

itineraries.name: Iceberg
itineraries.summary: The Iceberg is a liveaboard taking 8 guests on diving safaris in Egypt’s Red Sea. Itineraries range from a single-day trip to week-long trips exploring the northern Red Sea’s best dive sites.

itineraries.name: Jackson Reef Liveaboard Diving
itineraries.summary: Jackson Reef liveaboard diving can be epitomised in one word: Sharks! Aside from the usual reef sharks, from June to September there is a large influx of scalloped hammerhead sharks, with occasional tiger and whale shark sightings. There are vast shoals of fish living in this colorful reef.

itineraries.name: JP Marine
itineraries.summary: MY JP Marine is a spacious liveaboard designed for the comfort of divers. 14 en-suite bathrooms, 2 sundecks, lounge, dining room & bar. The JP Marine yacht explores the best dive sites of the Red Sea.

itineraries.name: Lady M
itineraries.summary: Experience Red Sea liveaboard diving aboard the Lady M, offering comfort and access to iconic sites like Brothers, Daedalus, Elphinstone, Fury Shoals, and St. John’s.

itineraries.name: Marselia Star
itineraries.summary: Sail the Red Sea aboard Marselia Star, a modern 12-cabin liveaboard with diver lift, tech diving support, and itineraries to Egypt’s top reefs, wrecks, and shark sites.

itineraries.name: New Sambo
itineraries.summary: The New Sambo liveaboard offers a Red Sea diving experience with daily happy hours, onboard yoga classes, and a unique outdoor BBQ on a spacious sun terrace.

itineraries.name: Ocean Lovers
itineraries.summary: Dive Egypt's Red Sea treasures! Ocean Lovers liveaboard offers iconic wrecks and stunning marine life

itineraries.name: Oceanix
itineraries.summary: Explore Egypt’s Red Sea aboard Oceanix, a modern 24-guest liveaboard offering en-suite cabins, spacious sun decks, Nitrox, and thrilling dive safaris.

itineraries.name: MY Odyssey Liveaboard
itineraries.summary: Join the Odyssey yacht for an exciting Red Sea dive safari. Bright & colourful she caters for up to 26 guests in 13 en-suite modern cabins, dining room, indoor & outdoor lounge & sundeck with hot tub.

itineraries.name: Queen Sherry
itineraries.summary: Explore the Red Sea aboard the Queen Sherry liveaboard, accommodating 24 guests in 12 cabins. Dive iconic sites and enjoy unique dolphin encounters with an onboard specialist.

itineraries.name: Red Sea Aggressor II
itineraries.summary: Egypt's finest liveaboard! Red Sea Aggressor II delivers stunning Red Sea reefs, wrecks and thrilling dives

itineraries.name: Red Sea Aggressor IV
itineraries.summary: The Red Sea Aggressor IV is a 43.5 meters/142.7 feet long liveaboard sailing from Port Ghalib, in Egypt’s Red Sea, taking 26 passengers in 13 cabins to the best dive sites in the Southern Red Sea.

itineraries.name: Red Sea Aggressor V
itineraries.summary: The Red Sea Aggressor V is a liveaboard offering comfortable accommodations, top-tier amenities, and diving adventures in Egypt’s southern Red Sea.

itineraries.name: Red Sea Blue Force 2
itineraries.summary: The Red Sea Blue Force 2 offers itineraries that cover the best of the Red Sea dive sites. Catering to up to 18 guests she has 10 en-suite cabins with air-conditioning, lounge, dining room & sun deck.

itineraries.name: Red Sea Explorer
itineraries.summary: Sail the Red Sea on MY Red Sea Explorer, a 43m (141ft) liveaboard with 12 cabins for 24 guests, offering up to 4 dives daily, Nitrox, and departures from Hurghada or Port Ghalib.

itineraries.name: Reef Voyager
itineraries.summary: Explore the Red Sea aboard Reef Voyager, a modern liveaboard with top diving facilities, and unforgettable wreck and reef itineraries.

itineraries.name: Rocky Liveaboard Diving
itineraries.summary: Rocky Island liveaboards have almost everything Red Sea diving has to offer. Huge, shallow, colorful coral reefs make for stunning photographs. Whilst doing swim-throughs and drift dives, be sure to look out for shoals of striped grunts, hunting barracuda, hammerheads and oceanic whitetip sharks.

itineraries.name: Royal Evolution
itineraries.summary: The Royal Evolution is a 39-meter liveaboard accommodating 24 passengers in 12 air-conditioned cabins, comprising 2 double suites, 2 twin suites, and 8 standard suite cabins, all with private bathrooms with hot showers.

itineraries.name: Safy Mar
itineraries.summary: Dive the Egyptian Red Sea aboard Safy Mar, a 2024-built liveaboard for 34 divers, with routes to St. John's, Fury Shoal, the Brothers and Tiran.

itineraries.name: Salem Express Liveaboard Diving
itineraries.summary: After running aground in 1991 carrying pilgrims back from Mecca, the Salem Express sank and took the lives of over half of those on board. A liveaboard here is more of a historical dive than one concerned with marine life, with the vehicles and packed luggage of the ill-fated passengers still clearly on show.

itineraries.name: Sea Friend
itineraries.summary: The Sea Friend liveaboard departs directly from Hamata to offer less time for traveling and more time for exploring the stunning reefs of the southern Red Sea. Each cabin features en-suite bathrooms, AC, and storage space.

itineraries.name: Sea Serpent
itineraries.summary: The unique hull design of the 34m MY Sea Serpent ensures the smoothest voyage to the best Red Sea diving destinations, including the spectacular Brother Islands, Elphinstone Reef and Daedalus.

itineraries.name: Sea Serpent Contessa
itineraries.summary: Offering year-round trips to the Red Sea, the 34m Sea Serpent Contessa accommodates up to 24 divers in 12 spacious cabins, each fitted with air conditioning and en-suite bathrooms.

itineraries.name: Sea Serpent Excellence
itineraries.summary: Itineraries aboard the MY Sea Serpent Excellence include the famous sites of the Red Sea, such as the Tiran Strait, the Brother Islands, Daedalus, and Elphinstone. The Sea Serpent Excellence is fitted with 12 en-suite cabins.

itineraries.name: Sea Serpent Grand
itineraries.summary: Exploring the wreck of the SS Thistlegorm is about as comfortable as it can possibly get while sailing aboard the huge 45m MY Sea Serpent Grand. Her 14 luxury en-suite cabins ensure maximum comfort.

itineraries.name: Serenity
itineraries.summary: The Serenity is a 33-meter/108-foot liveaboard taking 24 guests on diving trips through Egypt’s Red Sea in 12 spacious air-conditioned cabins with ensuite facilities.

itineraries.name: Shark and Yolanda Reefs Liveaboard Diving
itineraries.boat: Shark and Yolanda Reefs Liveaboard Diving
itineraries.summary: Shark and Yolanda Reef liveaboard diving offers guests a stunning reef teeming with critters and surrounded by huge shoals of fish such as barracuda, jackfish and batfish. The wreck of the Yolanda has its cargo strewn all over the sea floor which includes bathtubs, toilets and even an old BMW.

itineraries.name: Sinai Liveaboard Diving
itineraries.summary: Diving around the Sinai Peninsula, Egypt, offers an unforgettable underwater adventure in the heart of the Red Sea. With its crystal-clear waters, vibrant coral reefs, and diverse marine life, this region is a paradise for divers seeking exploration, excitement, and natural beauty.

itineraries.name: Sinaistar
itineraries.summary: Dive the Red Sea aboard the Sinaistar—13 cabins, spacious dive deck, sun deck, and weekly trips from Hurghada.

itineraries.name: Sindalahs
itineraries.summary: Explore the Red Sea aboard Sindalahs, a liveaboard offering 7-day dive trips to iconic sites like Brothers, Daedalus, Elphinstone, and Saint John. Gourmet cuisine and top-tier amenities for 26 guests.

itineraries.name: Snefro Love
itineraries.summary: The Snefro Love liveaboard departs from Sharm el Sheikh for week-long dive safaris in the Straits of Tiran. She caters for 20 guests in 10 cabins.

itineraries.name: Snefro Pearl
itineraries.summary: The Snefro Pearl liveaboard is perfect for small groups of 12 divers. Itineraries are 4-8 days. Explore Ras Mohammed, The Straits of Tiran and the Thistlegorm during a Red Sea dive safari.

itineraries.name: Snefro Target
itineraries.summary: Join the Snefro Target for fantastic Northern Red Sea diving. Explore Shark & Yolanda, the Thistlegorm as well as the famous reefs in the Straits of Tiran.

itineraries.name: South Moon 1
itineraries.summary: The South Moon 1 is a 30m Red Sea liveaboard offering comfortable cabins, excellent dive facilities, international cuisine, and iconic itineraries to the region’s best reefs and wrecks.

itineraries.name: SS Glorious Miss Nouran
itineraries.summary: The Sea Serpent Glorious Miss Nouran liveaboard operates in the Egyptian Red Sea and has 13 ensuite cabins for up to 26 guests. Itineraries visit favorite sites such as Daedalus, Brothers, Elphinstone, and the SS Thistlegorm.

itineraries.name: SS Serena Dreams
itineraries.summary: Join the fantastic Sea Serpent Serena Dreams for a Red Sea diving liveaboard to remember. Built by divers for divers to offer unforgettable diving in the Red Sea. 9 en-suite guest cabins accommodate 18 passengers.

itineraries.name: Star Jet
itineraries.summary: Experience the Red Sea aboard Star Jet, a liveaboard with 15 cabins, sundecks, gourmet cuisine, and itineraries to Brothers, Daedalus, Ras Mohammed, and the Thistlegorm.

itineraries.name: Sunlight
itineraries.summary: Having undergone a complete renovation in 2019, the MY Sunlight is ready to show off the best of the Red Sea. A choice of routes is available including North, South and Deep South. 10 air-conditioned cabins with ensuite bathrooms cater to 20 guests.

itineraries.name: Sunshine
itineraries.summary: The M/Y Sunshine yacht offers year-round dive safaris in the Red Sea. 10 en-suite cabins with AC cater to 20 guests. Itineraries are 5-7 nights long and explore the northern and southern routes.

itineraries.name: Tala
itineraries.summary: Join the MV Tala liveaboard for a Red Sea diving safari. Exploring some of the best dive areas in the region such as Brothers, Daedalus, Elphinstone and the SS Thistlegorm, she is perfectly set up for tech divers with a range of mixes and tanks.

itineraries.name: Topaz
itineraries.summary: Dive into the Red Sea aboard Scuba Liveaboard Egypt—an all-inclusive liveaboard offering ensuite cabins, daily dives, and expert instruction for all levels, from beginner to pro.

itineraries.name: Unity
itineraries.summary: Discover the Unity Liveaboard in the Red Sea, offering 13 ensuite cabins for 24 guests. Enjoy unforgettable dive trips to iconic reefs, wrecks, and shark hotspots.

itineraries.name: Vita Xplorer
itineraries.summary: Explore some of the best Red Sea dive sites aboard the Vita Xplorer. Dive the Ras Mohammed Marine Park, Thistlegorm, & Abu Nuhas Wrecks, as well as Elphinstone, Brothers, & Daedalus Reef.

itineraries.name: Woodhouse Reef Liveaboard Diving
itineraries.summary: Woodhouse Reef being nearly a mile long, liveaboards here specialise in drift diving, especially in the aptly named Washing Machine. This reef also offers a sandy-bottomed canyon full of colorful corals and macro life. A large variety of sharks, rays and turtles take respite from the current here.

itineraries.name: Yachtiano
itineraries.summary: The Yachtiano is a 45.5-meter/149-foot liveaboard that accommodates 34 passengers for diving in the Red Sea. It offers exclusive itineraries full of wrecks, walls, coral gardens, and marine life.

itineraries.name: Zabargad Liveaboard Diving
itineraries.summary: Zabargad liveaboards offer guests the chance to go diving on a wreck of an old Russian spy ship in just 24m of calm water. Penetrate the engine room and bridge to discover hoards of glassfish. Octopus, squid, eels, rays, turtles, oceanic whitetips, hammerheads and reef sharks can be spotted too.

itineraries.name: Egypt Liveaboard Diving
itineraries.summary: Thousands of divers flock to liveaboards in Egypt every year to experience the warm and crystal clear waters of the Red Sea. Huge coral reefs, wrecks and offshore drop-offs with spectacular pelagic action can be seen when diving.

itineraries.name: Red Sea Liveaboard Diving
itineraries.summary: Considered some of the best diving in the world for its warm and clear waters, a Red Sea liveaboard offers divers a chance to experience the Straits of Tiran and Ras Mohammed National Park. There are also the ecosystems clinging to the wrecks of the SS Thistlegorm and the Dunraven to explore.
